mentions.name: USBSID-Pico
mentions.description: A Raspberry Pi Pico/PicoW (RP2040) and Pico2/Pico2W (RP2350) based board for interfacing one or two MOS SID chips and/or hardware SID emulators over (Web)USB with a computer, phone, ASID-supporting player, or USB MIDI controller. Version 1.5 is an improved PCB without jumpers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just released USBSID-Pico v1.5 an improved pcb without jumpers. USBSID-Pico is a RaspberryPi Pico/PicoW (RP2040) & Pico2/Pico2W (RP2350) based board for interfacing one or two MOS SID chips and/or hardware SID emulators over (WEB)USB with your computer, phone, ASID supporting player or USB midi controller.
